title: Bhai ka gala kat te bahen dekh rahi hai
body:
BHAI KA GALA KAT TE BAHEN DEKH RAHI HAI
KYA KOI YAHAAN SAHEBE IMMAN NAHI HAI, KYA KOI YAHAN HAMILE QURAAN NAHI HAI, AADA SE YEHI PUCHHTI HAI ZAINAB-E-KUBRA
GHABRATI HAI SAR PEET TI HAI HOTI HAI MUZTAR, SAHIL KO KABHI TAK TI HAI BECHAIN WO HOKAR, HASRAT SE KABHI SOO-E-WATAN DEKH RAHI HAI
CHALNE KO HAI AB SHEH RAGHE SHABBIR PA KHANJAR, HAR SIMT HIRAASANI HAI GHUMGEEN HAI MANZAR, LOOT TA HUA ZEHRA KA CHAMAN DEKH RAHI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
HADH HOGAYI HADH HOGAYI AB JOR-O-JAFA KI, BHEEGI HUI AANKHOU SE PAIYAMBAR KI NAWASI, BADLA HUA UMMAT KA CHALAN DEKH RAHI HAI
BECHAIN HAI DIL ZARB-E-MASAAIB KE SABAB SE, AATI HAI WATAN CHOOD KE ISS DASHT MAIN JAB SE, NAAZO KI PALI RANJ-O-MEHAN DEKH RAHI HAI
SAR PAR BHI NA REH PAYEGI AB SHAAM SE CHADAR, REH JAYEGI BE GOR-O-KAFAN LAASHE BARADAR, MUMKIN NAHI TATBEERE KAFAN DEKH RAHI HAI
LO HO CHUKI WO DEKHO SAR-O-TAN MAIN JUDAYI, LO CHUT GAYA HUMSHEER SE PARDES MAIN BHAI, HASRAT SE BAHEN DEKHO HASAN DEKH RAHI HAI
